race_name: Gran Fondo Cycling Challenge – Ciudad de Panamá

top_categories.workout_context: 74ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Gran Fondo Cycling Challenge – Ciudad de Panamá, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Cycling Challenge – Ciudad de Panamá. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 83, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Cycling Challenge – Ciudad de Panamá's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
6,132ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.

Gran Fondo Cycling Challenge – Ciudad de Panamá's road route from historic Panama City, over the forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 83 miles.
6,132ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 83 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on road route from historic Panama City, over the. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 6,132ft of climbing on road route from historic Panama City, over the does to your power file on race day.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Gran Fondo Cycling Challenge – Ciudad de Panamá, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Gran Fondo Cycling Challenge – Ciudad de Panamá’s 83 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and G Spot to prepare you for 83 miles of road route from historic panama city, over the panama canal, into rural panamá oeste in Panama City (Casco Viejo start, 2026) to Panamá Oeste pineapple country, crossing the Puente de las Américas over the Panama Canal.
